title: Reinstating Ridgecrest Advantage Coverage Terminated for Non-Payment Where Good Cause Is Shown
content:
A member whose Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan coverage was terminated for non-payment may ask to be reinstated where the failure to pay was caused by circumstances beyond their control.

### Conditions of record

1. **The window is open.** The member asks for reinstatement no later than the last day of the reinstatement window counted from the coverage end date recorded on the terminated enrollment. Calendar days are counted from the day after that coverage end date, every day of the week counts, a request made on the final day of the window is still in time, and full 24-hour periods are never used in place of calendar days. The terminated enrollment record is the authority, tested before the reinstatement is processed and matched on the enrollment reference.
2. **Good cause is determined.** A good-cause determination for this enrollment is recorded on the enrollment intake by the plan's reinstatement reviewer before the reinstatement is processed. The enrollment intake record is the authority, tested before the reinstatement is processed and matched on the reference of that request.

### What reinstatement does

Reinstatement restores the original coverage effective date with no gap, and the member must pay every premium owed for the months the coverage is restored for.

### The member's account and the reviewer's decision

The member's own account of why they could not pay is taken as the explanation but never as the determination: without the reviewer's recorded decision the reinstatement is refused, and a refused member is told which election period is next open to them.

### Once only

Reinstatement is granted once for any one terminated enrollment; a second request on the same enrollment is refused whatever the reason given.

### Boundary cases

| Circumstance | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| The request is made on the day before the last day of the reinstatement window, and the reviewer's determination is recorded | The window is open and good cause is determined; the reinstatement is processed |
| The request is made on the final day of the reinstatement window | Still in time; that day is inside the window |
| The request is made on the day after the last day of the window | Out of time |
| The request is made inside the window, and the member gives a full account of the illness that stopped them paying, but no determination is recorded on the intake | Refused, and the member is told which election period is next open to them |
